newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper, nickel, tin bounce back after losses.
newsitem.headline: India copper, nickel, tin bounce back after losses.

text.p: Indian copper, nickel and tin prices bounced back after recent losses on the local market on Thursday, dealers said.
Other base metals were steady in limited activity. Copper rose by 50 rupees at 13,750 rupees per quintal on the back of renewed industrial buying.
"Offer prices of Hindustan Copper Ltd. are higher compared to prevailing prices in the local market which in turn has shifted demand to the local market," one broker said.
Nickel rose 100 rupees at 36,500 rupees per quintal on the back of recovery in the world market while tin rose by 200 rupees at 31,400 rupees on renewed local support.
Zinc was steady at 8,050 rupees after losing 50 rupees on Wednesday while lead was quiet at 4,100 rupees as was aluminium at 7,700 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
